desc: Derive and verify the binomial identity: answer = Σ_{j=1..N} Σ_{t=0..K} C(K,t)(−1)^{K−t} S_j^t · (Σ_{i<j} S_i^{K−t}), where S_0=0 and prefix sums are taken mod p.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K,t) and sign factors (−1)^{K−t} mod 998244353 for K ≤ 10.

Implement single-pass algorithm: iterate j from 1..N with S_0 = 0 included as a "previous" prefix (P[0]=1 initially), maintain array P[m] = Σ of S_i^m over seen prefixes, compute contribution of current S_j before adding it into P.
Compute powers S_j^t efficiently via incremental multiplication (pw[0]=1, pw[t]=pw[t−1]·s mod p) — O(NK) total.
Write full Python solution with fast stdin reading, verify against Sample 1 (75) and Sample 2 (0) by reasoning, and confirm mod handling of negative signs.
